title: 300th Anniversary University Professor
bio: Martha Minow holds the 300th Anniversary University Professorship at Harvard University; she has taught at Harvard Law School since 1981 and served as dean for eight years (2009-2017). An expert in constitutional law and human rights, her work has focused on issues of exclusion and discrimination, legal responses to social, political, and religious conflict, and legal treatments of […]
